replay_assumptions: Same simulator, RNG, mobility, cache and pre-origin history. Prefix parity must be checked after replay.
fallback_policy: Hold-current is a proposed fallback, never counted as a returned feasible plan. LLM-only infeasible submissions remain included.
reuse_policy: 81 verified completed prefix-matching old trajectories reused; six mismatches and one matched Case5 approval reference queued again. Local retries preserve old outputs.

allocation_model.fairness_policy: PC3 and PC4 each receive three complete waves. PC2 remains five waves, server remains three waves. PC1 receives the balancing 16 jobs in addition to its prior allocation.
allocation_model.optimality: With PC2 fixed at five waves, server fixed at three waves, equal PC3/PC4 wave counts, and 368 executions, six PC-cycle equivalents is the shortest full-wave allocation. This includes PC1 already-started first wave; actual remaining time depends on current progress.
allocation_model.reference_repeat_reason: 367 required executions is odd while all machine wave sizes are even. Add one useful Case5 approval replay on PC4 with the five Case5 prefix rechecks, not a new evaluation sample.
